data.one_liner: Parses Gherkin .feature files into Cucumber Messages envelopes
data.what_it_does: This package reads Gherkin feature files and converts them into Cucumber Messages envelopes. It is a pure Dart implementation that works on all platforms supported by Dart.
use_when: Parsing Gherkin feature files for BDD tests
Generating Cucumber Messages for test runners
strengths: Cross‑platform support (android, ios, web, windows, macos, linux)
weaknesses: No code generation or test runner integration built in
Limited to parsing, not executing tests
